II. Modular OS and Virtualization Layers
A modular OS uses loadable kernel modules (LKMs) — drivers and services are linked at runtime,
which lets a virtualization layer (hypervisor) be integrated cleanly, as in Linux KVM.
The hypervisor runs on the HOST and creates GUEST virtual machines, each with its own OS.
